THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
107
STUDY 095
Black & White Bow Knit & Feather Cuffs
Rights check
Source: 24979.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with shoulder-length auburn
waves and blunt bangs stands in a warm beige room.
She wears a black cropped long-sleeve knit with a
white ribbed bib panel, a black satin bow at the neck,
and black feather-trimmed cuffs. A black knit maxi skirt
with a white ribbed waistband completes the look. Her
expression is calm, with a soft smile. Warm, even
interior light. Palette of black, white, and warm auburn.
Elegant and playful, in the style of a retro knitwear
editorial.
Elegant, playful, retro
WORKING NOTES
- The white bib and feather cuffs are the signature details.
- Use 'top-down angle' to show the skirt and shape.
